text:
Ivy L: quick copy help. users can bulk-cancel running inference jobs from the Jobs table. want to make the confirmation dialog clear about billing and irreversible effects. sketch: https://redwood.design/bulk-cancel-sketch :paperclip:
Noah M: two label candidates for primary CTA:
  1) `Cancel jobs` (neutral/short)
  2) `Stop and cancel jobs` (explicit about stopping compute)
Priya S: also need a succinct body sentence. options:
  A) `Are you sure you want to cancel 12 running jobs? This will stop them immediately.`
  B) `Cancelling will stop running jobs immediately and you may still incur charges for used resources.`
Noah M: prefer A for clarity and brevity in the dialog body, and add a small secondary line about billing. e.g. body A + helper text: `Billing note: charges for resources used up to cancellation may still apply.`
Ivy L: wording nit: avoid legal-y phrasing. maybe: `Some charges may apply for work already completed.`
Priya S: love that. also consider emphasizing irreversibility: `This action cannot be undone.` But that feels scary; maybe only show that for long-running batch cancels where artifacts will be deleted.
Noah M: suggestion: show contextual copy based on selection: if user selected jobs that produce artifacts with stored outputs and the deletion toggle is on, include irreversible sentence. otherwise omit.
Design Bot: accessibility checklist: 1) primary CTA should be descriptive to screen readers (e.g., `aria-label="Cancel 12 running jobs"`) 2) dialog should have role=dialog and focus trap 3) ensure the confirmation text is within `aria-describedby` 4) make secondary billing note visible to assistive tech 5) ensure color contrast for danger button meets 4.5:1 if it's primary
Ivy L: ok. final copy proposal:
  - heading: `Cancel running jobs?`
  - body: `Are you sure you want to cancel 12 running jobs? This will stop them immediately.`
  - helper (smaller text): `Some charges may apply for work already completed.`
  - primary CTA: `Cancel jobs` (with aria-label: `Cancel 12 running jobs`)
  - secondary/neutral: `Keep jobs running`
Priya S: tiny nit: heading sentence-case -> `Cancel running jobs?` is good. make helper text slightly softer: `You may still be billed for work completed before cancellation.`
Noah M: approved with that helper tweak. :white_check_mark:
Design Bot: recorded decision: contextual dialog copy + primary CTA `Cancel jobs` + aria-label usage + helper billing sentence `You may still be billed for work completed before cancellation.` Ivy will add copy variants for when artifacts are deleted and when bulk-size > 50 (suggest extra confirm step).
